same_runtime.definition: research venv runtime identity equal to the 4D.4J-A freeze (macOS arm64, Python 3.11.17, torch 2.10.0, numpy 1.26.4, one intra/inter-op thread, deterministic algorithms)
same_runtime.rule: exact equality of encoded inputs (bitwise, including signed zeros), raw logits, legal probabilities, values, root visits, original actions, guard diagnostics (excluding timing) and final actions

cross_runtime.definition: production Docker image (linux/arm64, CPU-only torch) or any runtime whose identity differs from the 4D.4J-A freeze
cross_runtime.encoded_inputs: exact bitwise equality, including signed zeros
cross_runtime.terminal_handling: exact equality (terminal and malformed roots rejected)
cross_runtime.blocker_rule: any unexplained root-visit or action difference blocks the integration recommendation; differences are reported, never tolerated silently

load_time_self_check.rule: max absolute difference of logits and value on the manifest reference positions <= 0.0001, else the agent is unavailable
